messages:
leo: Quick flag: Gemma-lite 3B import into our runtime seems to have a head-order mismatch. Long-context translation BLEU dropped ~2.4 on the small-mt suite :eyes:

leo: Symptoms: short prompts OK, but past ~512 tokens outputs start drifting (repeats & wrong alignment). kv-cache inspection shows keys are not lining up headwise.

anya: did we apply the head-permute mapping from the conversion guide? sometimes Gemma forks use a different head interleave than our default.

leo: we ran the standard convert + reorder script. below is the quick check I ran to compare per-head norms:```python
import numpy as np, json
W=np.load('converted/attn_k.npy') # shape (heads, dim, dim_head)
norms=[np.linalg.norm(W[h]) for h in range(W.shape[0])]
print(norms[:8])
```

leo: the pattern of norms vs the reference model is permuted (e.g. head 0 matches ref head 3, head1 -> ref head7 etc). when I remapped keys with a guessed perm the longctx BLEU recovered.

ops-bot: started job bench-59987 (long-mt-suite) by leo

bench-bot: bench-59987 finished 1: BLEU baseline (converted) 18.6 -> patched-remap 20.9 (+2.3). latency +1.2ms, mem same.

sophia: nice find. so conversion script should detect head-ordering equivalence automatically. propose: compute a per-head signature (e.g., mean of key vectors vs ref) and infer permutation mapping, then reorder weights and kv-cache mapping during import.

anya: agreed. also add a quick unit test that constructs a random permuted-head weight and verifies the importer recovers original up to tol. I'll draft PR.

leo: for triage: 1) add auto-detect perm step, 2) add kv-cache mapping assertion in runtime (if cache hits drop by headwise mismatch pattern raise warning), 3) run sweep for int8/int4 quant to ensure perm reorder remains stable across quantization.

ops-bot: created issue #ML-6123 import: auto-detect head perm + kv-cache assert :lock:

anya: small note: when we permute, be careful about fused qkv layouts (some exports pack heads differently). our reconstructor should detect pack format first.

leo: noted. I'll attach minimal failing model to the issue and a repro script.

bench-bot: re-run job bench-59988 (after PR patch) queued by anya

bench-bot: bench-59988 finished 1: BLEU patched 21.0, regression cleared. ETA for PR merge EOD, will add tests and perf sweep. :white_check_mark:

leo: thanks all. saving logs and the head-perm detective script to the onboarding ticket.
